table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ReceiptCode,
	InstallmentRowID,
	InstallmentAmount,
	InstallmentDate=GETDATE(),
	InstallmentBalance,
	AmtReceived,
	ReceivedOn,
	ReceivedAccCode,
	PaymentMode,
	RefNo,
	Discount,
	Fine,
	GlVochCode, 
	GlVochCodeDiscount, 
	GlVochCodeFine,
	Remarks
FROM 
	InstallmentReceiptDetail
WHERE
	ReceiptCode = :ai_code
